findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed that the handwashing sink in the serving kitchen had no hot water, only cold water (the hot water lever produced no water when turned). CORRECTED: PIC removed the handwashing sink from service and instead re-designated the triple sink in the serving kitchen for handwashing only until the handwashing sink can be repaired. The triple sink does have both hot and cold water. All warewashing of utensils and equipment from the serving kitchen will instead be done in the main kitchen which has adequate equipment for warewashing. Ensure that handwashing sinks are equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 85 F.
findings.citation_text: 5-202.12(A) Handwashing Sink, Installation. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 29.4°C (85°F) through a mixing valve or combination faucet. [Pf]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed a mop in the main cooking kitchen that was stored in the bottom basin of the mop bucket in water where it cannot properly air-dry. CORRECTED: PIC moved the mop to the upper basket where the mop can effectively air-dry between uses. Ensure that mops are stored properly so that they can air-dry and not attract pests or mildew.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the facility’s chemical dish sanitizing machine to not be dispensing Cl (0-10 ppm) bleach after multiple runs. CORRECTED- The facility re-primed the machine and replaced the sanitizing solution. The sanitizer was observed to properly be dispensing a sanitizer solution at 200 ppm. Use the facility’s test strips to ensure that chemical dish machines used for sanitation of food contact surfaces are dispensing at a concentration of 50-200 ppm.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A). [P]

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the handle of the ice scoop (intended for drinks) to be touching the ice. CORRECTED- the person in charge (PIC) placed a metal container for storage of the ice scoop. Ensure food contact surfaces with handles are stored with the handles above or separate from the food to prevent accidental bare-hand contamination of food.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.12(A) In-Use Utensils, Between-Use Storage. During pauses in FOOD preparation or dispensing, FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) Except as specified under (B) of this section, in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container. [C]
